clauses.1.1: These terms apply to orders placed while this version is in force. Your order confirmation names the version and its fingerprint.
clauses.2.1: Changed your mind? Return unused items in their original packaging within 120 days of delivery. We refund the item price to your original payment method.
clauses.2.2: For change-of-mind returns we send you a free return label.
clauses.2.3: Delivery charges are not refunded for change-of-mind returns.
clauses.3.1: If an item arrives damaged, tell us within 14 days of delivery and send a photo. We refund the item and the delivery charge or send a replacement, and we pay return shipping.
clauses.3.2: If we send the wrong item, tell us within 30 days of delivery. We refund the item and the delivery charge or send the right item, and we pay return shipping.
clauses.3.3: If an item stops working within 365 days of delivery, we repair it, replace it or refund it. We pay return shipping.
clauses.3.4: If your order has not arrived 14 days after dispatch, we refund the item and the delivery charge or send it again.
clauses.4.1: Personalised items (engraved or made to your measurements) cannot be returned because you changed your mind. Faults are still covered by clause 3.3.
clauses.5.1: If you disagree with how we applied these terms, you can take the case to the Open Resolution Desk procedure (ord/1). We follow its computed outcome for these terms. These terms do not limit any rights you have under the law.
